Case studies

B2C e-commerce

Indovaping.net

Website development · WordPress · WooCommerce · SEO

The challenge

Build an online sales channel where customers can browse the product catalog and complete transactions on the website, rather than relying only on other sales channels.

My role and execution

  • Built the website from scratch using WordPress and WooCommerce.
  • Prepared the page structure, product catalog, and website administration.
  • Supported the shopping flow configuration through to checkout.
  • Managed content needs and website SEO optimization.

Business outcome

The website grew into a sales channel that accepts transactions, with gross sales above Rp170 million (Rp171.3M from 685 orders, April 2024 to October 2026).

B2B digital catalog

CMWDistribution.com

Website catalog · Stock synchronization · Sales enablement

The challenge

The sales team needed a practical digital product catalog for offering products to business customers, with stock information based on warehouse availability.

My role and execution

  • Built a WordPress-based product catalog website.
  • Structured the catalog so product information is easy to find.
  • Developed a stock synchronization mechanism: stock and price updates are uploaded from Excel/CSV files through a custom admin panel, combining CMW and CWI warehouse stock.
  • Supported the sales team’s access to product and availability information, including an order cart that sends selected items to the sales admin via WhatsApp for follow-up.

Business outcome

Provided a digital catalog that supports product offers and gives the sales team easier access to stock availability.

Warehouse stock (Excel)→CSV upload in admin panel→Stock sync→Catalog website

Stock is updated by uploading a file, not in real time.

Operations and automation

Marketplace and inventory operations

Tokopedia · Shopee · Blibli · BigSeller · Excel

The challenge

Managing several marketplaces requires consistent stock monitoring and sales recording. Data differences between channels can complicate reconciliation and warehouse admin work.

My role and execution

  • Managed sales operations across three marketplaces.
  • Built a web-based stock synchronization tool that matches the master stock file (Excel) to Shopee, Tokopedia, Blibli, and TikTok Shop files by product keyword and variation, using a saved matching memory of 1,848 items.
  • Built a daily recap tool for warehouse admins: raw Excel exports from Tokopedia, Shopee, and Lynk ID are uploaded per channel and converted into one 14-column master format to match transactions with inventory data.
  • Used spreadsheets and operational tools for daily monitoring, including an Excel dashboard of transactions, pieces, and sales by marketplace and shipper.

Business outcome

Supported marketplace sales of Rp100 million+ per month, with better stock measurability and more orderly operational data.
